crossRefs.note: Strangers, the tyrants of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him. His branches have fallen on the mountains…
I will leave you on the land. I will cast you out on the open field, and will cause all the birds of the sky to settle…
I will lay your flesh on the mountains, and fill the valleys with your height.
You will fall on the mountains of Israel, you, and all your hordes, and the peoples who are with you. I will give you…
You will fall on the open field; for I have spoken it,” says the Lord Yahweh.
For Yahweh is enraged against all the nations, and angry with all their armies. He has utterly destroyed them. He has…

translations.web: I will fill its mountains with its slain. The slain with the sword will fall in your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses.
translations.bsb: I will fill its mountains with the slain; those killed by the sword will fall on your hills, in your valleys, and in all your ravines.
translations.kjv: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.
translations.asv: And I will fill its mountains with its slain: in thy hills and in thy valleys and in all thy watercourses shall they fall that are slain with the sword.
